title: Glowing bathtub
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- glow aura -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='46' ry='34' fill='#16324f' opacity='0.55'/>
  <!-- tub body -->
  <path d='M12 46 L88 46 L84 74 Q82 84 70 84 L30 84 Q18 84 16 74 Z' fill='#f4f7fb'/>
  <!-- tub rim -->
  <rect x='8' y='40' width='84' height='10' rx='5' fill='#cfe3f5'/>
  <rect x='8' y='40' width='84' height='4' rx='2' fill='#eaf4ff'/>
  <!-- water -->
  <path d='M17 56 L83 56 L80 72 Q79 80 69 80 L31 80 Q21 80 20 72 Z' fill='#39c6e8'/>
  <!-- water surface highlight -->
  <path d='M20 59 Q35 54 50 59 Q65 64 80 59 L80 63 Q65 68 50 63 Q35 58 20 63 Z' fill='#8ef0ff' opacity='0.85'/>
  <!-- bubbles -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='49' r='5' fill='#d9fbff'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='49' r='2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='46' r='7' fill='#d9fbff'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='46' r='3' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='50' r='4' fill='#d9fbff'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='50' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <rect x='22' y='84' width='10' height='6' rx='3' fill='#9fb6cc'/>
  <rect x='68' y='84' width='10' height='6' rx='3' fill='#9fb6cc'/>
  <!-- faucet -->
  <rect x='76' y='24' width='7' height='16' rx='3' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <rect x='70' y='20' width='18' height='7' rx='3.5' fill='#ffe08a'/>
  <!-- glowing rim sparkle -->
  <circle cx='14' cy='45' r='2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='86' cy='45' r='2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- glow lines -->
  <path d='M6 58 Q12 54 18 58' stroke='#5fe0ff' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M82 58 Q88 54 94 58' stroke='#5fe0ff' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
